description:
Upload documents (1–5; PDF, text, etc.) into an app's RAG sources (app-token / B2B variant of `ethora-source-doc-upload-legacy`). Async — content becomes queryable once indexing finishes; files passed as base64, 50MB max each.
Requires: a selected app (`ethora-app-select`) or an explicit `appId`.
Auth: app-token mode OR B2B mode with an explicit `appId`. Errors: 401/403 wrong auth; 404 unknown `appId`; 413 too large; 422 unsupported document type. Related: `ethora-source-doc-list`, `ethora-source-doc-delete`.

appId.description: 24-char hex appId to ingest into. Required in B2B mode unless already set via `ethora-app-select`; ignored in app-token mode.

files.description: 1 to 5 documents to ingest in this call.

base64.description: Document content, base64-encoded. A `data:...;base64,` prefix is accepted. Max 50MB decoded per file.

name.description: Document file name including extension, e.g. `handbook.pdf`.

name: ethora-source-doc-upload
title: Upload Knowledge Document
